reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis overstates the role of severe lattice distortion in promoting protective oxide films and assumes a single-phase structure is always superior, ignoring that many high-performing lightweight HEAs rely on multi-phase or precipitation-strengthened microstructures.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and comparative, but the falsification criterion is too strict (requiring simultaneous improvement in all three properties) and the link between lattice distortion and oxide coherence is not directly measured.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a central trade-off in lightweight HEA design and proposes a clean controlled experiment, but its oversimplified mechanism and weak grounding in existing observations limit its practical value.
